title: postmarketOS in 2026-07: libcamera 0.7.2
excerpt: Aiming for a 10 year life-cycle for smartphones
content_html:
The artwork above is a variation of a rollup banner for the upcoming FrOSCon event that Ranny has been working on. He shared a behind the scenes screenshot on Mastodon . Unless you are very familiar with the graphite graphics toolbox, you probably cannot imagine how complicated it looks. We are at DEFCON and FOSSY right now and will soon be at FrOSCon as well as our very own postmarketOS and Alpine Linux Conference. More on that as usual in the and what's next? section further below.

Organizational

  • Alicja is now a trusted contributor in postmarketOS!

Libcamera 0.7.2 and video calls

One of the most noticeable things that happened last month is the libcamera 0.7.2 release. Robert M. upgraded the postmarketOS edge package in !8991, dropping 11 (!) patches that he managed to upstream in the process. "The release notably includes fixes that allow us to start shipping color correction matrices in tuning files. This commit includes the current tuning iterations for the imx363 (used e.g. as Pixel 3a rear camera) and the s5kjn1 (used on e.g. as FairPhone 5 front camera). The later is also used for the other corresponding cameras on the mentioned devices, as they improve the quality over the default. This is, of course, planned to change in the future. The GPU-ISP also received major performance improvements, in particular if the dmabuf direct import path can be used. If that's not the case some INFO logs are printed, giving hints what needs to be improved in the V4L2 or GPU drivers."

He also fixed camera selection for pipewire/libcamera in mobile-config-firefox 5.4.1 (!138) and wrote: "So on devices with working cameras you should be able to do video calls now OOTB. Some sites might run into a remaining webrtc issue though (the camera freezing after a short time) - I have some pending patches for that, with a FF test build at aports!105606 (mrtest add -a 105605). With that all major video chat sides should work."

Thanks to Robert M. and the libcamera developers!

Duranium

  • The bug that Phosh would prompt to open sysext and confext loopback devices on boot via udiskie was fixed (#4767). Thanks Clayton!

  • Cups not starting was also fixed (#4649). Thanks Clayton!

  • phosh-os-updater was added and can now show duranium update notifications. Thanks Achill!

pmaports

  • linux-postmarketos-qcom-sdm670 was upgraded to 7.1.3 in !8940, fixing among other things audio for the Pixel 3a. See the sdm670-v7.1.3 tag for the full changelog. Thanks, Richard Ac. and everybody who tested!

  • The Librem 5 kernel was upgraded from 6.6 to 6.12 in !8959, importing fixes from upstream so that freezes on wakeup from suspend (#4207) no longer happen. Thanks Daniel K., dos and people who tested and helped finishing this up!

  • For systemd installs, sleep-inhibitor has been replaced in !8672. We now use systemd unit files and a small script to inhibit sleep when apk is running, as well as a pam config that uses systemd_pam (with upstreamed patches in !42275) to inhibit sleep when a session is open over ssh. Thanks, Clayton!

  • Non-adaptive apps are now hidden by default in Phosh, see the edge post and !8954. Thanks Achill!

  • The pinephone has been moved from the community category to testing (!9248): "The kernel version of linux-postmarketos-allwinner is older than six months. It has been a month since the warning issue was made, so this device must be demoted." If you use the pinephone and want it to be better supported in postmarketOS, consider helping out with getting the kernel upgraded. Thanks, Aster!

Misc

  • Victoria made Valve's Steam run really well on postmarketOS with the Ayaneo Pocket S2. She wrote a great blog post Taming the Steam arm64 client (on pmOS) that goes deep into how exactly it works and concludes with: "But the end result is beautiful. The device behaves like a little Steam Deck and you wouldn't notice, that it runs on a completely different processor architecture." Given that steam is proprietary software, we still need to discuss if and how we would make this available to users officially in postmarketOS. The full blog post is definitely worth reading, thank you very much Victoria!

  • Ranny and Antoine were interviewed about all things postmarketOS on the French podcast Projets Libres. If you understand French, you can give it a listen here: #70 – [Smartphone] postmarketOS : Linux pour faire durer votre smartphone pendant 10 ans ! — and if you don't, you can read the English transcript. This is one of several episodes that Projets Libres did on the Linux Mobile topic, there is e.g. #66 with Mobian founder Arnaud as well. Thanks Ranny, Antoine and Projets Libres team!

Powered by

The following people wrote patches that have been merged since the last monthly blog post. Thank you very much for improving postmarketOS!

Aster, Aelin, Clayton, Stefan, Oliver, Bart, Rob, Pablo, Achill, Ferass, Panagiotis, Barnabás, Nikita, Rudraksha, Daniel K., Sicelo, Dylan, Eric, Dawid, Robert M., Xelef2000, Luca, Alexey M., Fauzan, Ranny, Hugo P., Vladimir S., Henrik, Xu, Antoine, Jianhua, Nicola, erikas9987, Diego, ABOOTHAHIR, vognev, Kidd, Danila, Anton, Moritz, Lycheer, Zachariah, chiffa, Paul, MariooB, DrRac27, Raymond, Alicja, Richard Ac., Arnav, Alexandre, Duje, Federico, Wren, Eisenbahnfan, bluebunny, Ingo, Victoria, knuxify, Radnos, dikasp, Stanley

Furthermore we thank everybody who has been contributing to any of the numerous upstream projects we use (Alpine Linux, Linux kernel, Phosh, Plasma (Mobile), GNOME (Mobile), Sxmo, ModemManager, and so many more!). And of course everybody who has helped out in other ways, such as helping others to run postmarketOS (e.g. in chats or IRL), improving documentation in the wiki, doing infrastructure and organizational work, or donating to postmarketOS.

You are the people who make this possible!

And what's next?

  • We are attending quite a few events in August:

    • 2026-08-06 to 09: DEFCON 34 (Las Vegas, NV)
      • Ranny is looking for table volunteers. If you happen to be there and are willing to help with the table for a short period of time, reach out e.g. via #20!
    • 2026-08-06 to 09: FOSSY 2026 (Vancouver, CA)
    • 2026-08-15 to 17: FrOSCon 2026 (Sankt Augustin, DE)

  • And of course there is our very own postmarketOS and Alpine Linux Conference from 2026-09-25 to 27 in Aachen, DE. The Call for Proposals has just ended on the 31st of June, and we are happy to say that we have gotten many exciting talk proposals! Behind the scenes we are working on a schedule, as well as everything else that needs to be done to make the conference happen, organizing food, video recordings, lanyards and much more. Thanks to Aelin, Luca, Pablo, Ranny, Achill and Oliver!

Help wanted

  • "If you've ever wanted to give #postmarketOS device development a try, we're looking for help saving quite a few device ports from being archived" as Clayton writes on Fedi. "I have mad respect for folks who maintain and test device ports in pmOS, they're soo important to the continued development of #postmarketOS. For example, I rely on my Pixel 3a to help develop and test #duranium and other (hopefully) neat OS things, but I can't do those things if the device is not maintained and gets archived."

  • You can send us topics to include in the next blog post by commenting in: #235

  • If you appreciate the work we're doing with postmarketOS and want to support us, consider contributing financially via OpenCollective.

This blog post was written by Oliver. Header image by Ranny, Oliver.

• Victoria made Valve's Steam run really well on postmarketOS with the Ayaneo Pocket S2. She wrote a great blog post Taming the Steam arm64 client (on pmOS) that goes deep into how exactly it works and concludes with: "But the end result is beautiful. The device behaves like a little Steam Deck and you wouldn't notice, that it runs on a completely different processor architecture." Given that steam is proprietary software, we still need to discuss if and how we would make this available to users officially in postmarketOS. The full blog post is definitely worth reading, thank you very much Victoria!

sentences.zh: 该设备的行为就像一个小型 Steam Deck，您不会注意到它运行在完全不同的处理器架构上。”

sentences.en: Given that steam is proprietary software, we still need to discuss if and how we would make this available to users officially in postmarketOS.
sentences.zh: 鉴于 steam 是专有软件，我们仍然需要讨论是否以及如何在 postmarketOS 中正式向用户提供该软件。

sentences.en: The full blog post is definitely worth reading, thank you very much Victoria!
sentences.zh: 完整的博客文章绝对值得一读，非常感谢维多利亚！

content_html_zh:
上面的艺术作品是 Ranny 一直在为即将举行的 FrOSCon 活动制作的卷起横幅的变体。 他分享了 Mastodon 的幕后截图。 除非您非常熟悉石墨图形工具箱，否则您可能无法想象它看起来有多复杂。 我们现在正在参加 DEFCON 和 FOSSY，很快就会参加 FrOSCon 以及我们自己的 postmarketOS 和 Alpine Linux 会议。 像往常一样，更多关于这方面的内容，接下来会发生什么？ 下面进一步部分。

组织

  • Alicja 现在是 postmarketOS 中值得信赖的贡献者！

Libcamera 0.7.2 和视频通话

上个月发生的最引人注目的事情之一是 libcamera 0.7.2 版本。 罗伯特·M。 在 !8991 中升级了 postmarketOS Edge 软件包，下降了 11 (!) 他在此过程中设法向上游发布补丁。 “该版本特别包括修复程序，使我们能够开始在调整文件中传送色彩校正矩阵。 此提交包括 imx363（例如用作 Pixel 3a 后置摄像头）和 s5kjn1（例如用作 FairPhone 5 前置摄像头）的当前调整迭代。 后者也用于上述设备上的其他相应相机，因为它们比默认相机提高了质量。 当然，这种情况计划在未来改变。 GPU-ISP 还获得了重大性能改进，特别是如果可以使用 dmabuf 直接导入路径。 如果情况并非如此，则会打印一些 INFO 日志，提示 V4L2 或 GPU 驱动程序中需要改进的内容。”

他还在 mobile-config-firefox 5.4.1 (!138) 中修复了 pipeline/libcamera 的摄像头选择，并写道：“因此，在具有工作摄像头的设备上，您现在应该能够进行视频通话（OOTB）。 有些网站可能会遇到剩余的 webrtc 问题（相机在短时间内冻结） - 我有一些待处理的补丁，在 aports!105606 上进行 FF 测试构建（mrtest add -a 105605）。 这样一来，所有主要的视频聊天方都应该可以正常工作。”

感谢罗伯特·M. 以及 libcamera 开发人员！

杜拉尼姆

  • Phosh 在启动时通过 udiskie 提示打开 sysext 和 confext 环回设备的错误已修复 (#4767)。 谢谢克莱顿！
  • 杯子无法启动的问题也得到了修复（#4649）。 谢谢克莱顿！
  • 添加了 Phosh-os-updater，现在可以显示 duranium 更新通知。 谢谢阿基尔！

港务局

  • linux-postmarketos-qcom-sdm670 在 !8940 中升级到 7.1.3，修复了 Pixel 3a 的音频等问题。 请参阅 sdm670-v7.1.3 标签以获取完整的变更日志。 谢谢，理查德·阿克。 以及所有测试过的人！
  • Librem 5 内核在 !8959 中从 6.6 升级到 6.12，从上游导入修复程序，以便不再发生从挂起唤醒时冻结的情况 (#4207)。 感谢 Daniel K.、dos 以及测试并帮助完成此任务的人们！
  • 对于 systemd 安装，睡眠抑制剂已在 !8672 中被替换。 我们现在使用 systemd 单元文件和一个小脚本来在 apk 运行时抑制睡眠，以及使用 systemd_pam（在 !42275 中包含上游补丁）的 pam 配置来在通过 ssh 打开会话时抑制睡眠。 谢谢，克莱顿！
  • 非自适应应用程序现在默认隐藏在 Phosh 中，请参阅边缘帖子和 !8954。 谢谢阿基尔！
  • pinephone 已从社区类别移至测试类别 (!9248)：“linux-postmarketos-allwinner 的内核版本已超过六个月。 距离发出警告已经一个月了，因此该设备必须被降级。” 如果您使用 pinephone 并希望在 postmarketOS 中得到更好的支持，请考虑帮助升级内核。 谢谢，艾斯特！

Misc

  • Victoria 使用 Ayaneo Pocket S2 使 Valve 的 Steam 在 postmarketOS 上运行得非常好。 她写了一篇很棒的博文《驯服 Steam arm64 客户端（在 pmOS 上）》，深入探讨了它的工作原理，并总结道：“但最终结果很漂亮。 该设备的行为就像一个小型 Steam Deck，您不会注意到它运行在完全不同的处理器架构上。” 鉴于 steam 是专有软件，我们仍然需要讨论是否以及如何在 postmarketOS 中正式向用户提供该软件。 完整的博客文章绝对值得一读，非常感谢维多利亚！
  • Ranny 和 Antoine 在法国播客 Projets Libres 上接受了有关 postmarketOS 的所有采访。 如果您懂法语，可以在这里听一下：#70 – [智能手机] postmarketOS : Linux pour faire durer votre smart pendant 10 ans ！ - 如果你不这样做，你可以阅读英文成绩单。 这是 Projets Libres 就 Linux Mobile 主题所做的几集之一，例如#66 以及 Mobian 创始人 Arnaud。 感谢 Ranny、Antoine 和 Projets Libres 团队！

供电

以下人员编写了自上次每月博客文章以来已合并的补丁。 非常感谢您改进 postmarketOS！

Aster、Aelin、Clayton、Stefan、Oliver、Bart、Rob、Pablo、Achill、Ferass、Panagiotis、Barnabás、Nikita、Rudraksha、Daniel K.、Sicelo、Dylan、Eric、Dawid、Robert M.、Xelef2000、Luca、Alexey M.、Fauzan、Ranny、Hugo P.、Vladimir、Vlamir、S. Antoine、徐、安托万、徐.建华、Nicola、erikas9987、Diego、ABOOTHAHIR、vognev、Kidd、Danila、Anton、Moritz、Lycheer、Zachariah、chiffa、Paul、MariooB、DrRac27、Raymond、Alicja、Richard Ac.、Arnav、Alexandre、Duje、Federico、Wren、Eisenbahn、Ifanfy、blue knungo、Victoria、Knuxi拉德诺斯、双翅目、斯坦利

此外，我们感谢所有为我们使用的众多上游项目做出贡献的人（Alpine Linux、Linux 内核、Phosh、Plasma（移动）、GNOME（移动）、Sxmo、ModemManager 等等！）。 当然还有以其他方式提供帮助的每个人，例如帮助其他人运行 postmarketOS（例如在聊天或 IRL 中）、改进 wiki 中的文档、进行基础设施和组织工作或向 postmarketOS 捐款。

你们是让这一切成为可能的人！

接下来呢？

  • 我们在 8 月参加了很多活动：2026 年 8 月 6 日至 09 日：DEFCON 34（内华达州拉斯维加斯）Ranny 正在寻找餐桌志愿者。 如果您恰好在那里并且愿意在短时间内帮忙处理餐桌，请与我们联系，例如：通过 #20!2026-08-06 至 09：FOSSY 2026（加利福尼亚州温哥华）2026-08-15 至 17：FrOSCon 2026（德国圣奥古斯丁）
  • 当然，还有我们自己的 postmarketOS 和 Alpine Linux 会议，将于 2026 年 9 月 25 日至 27 日在德国亚琛举行。 提案征集活动于 6 月 31 日刚刚结束，我们很高兴地说我们收到了许多令人兴奋的演讲提案！ 在幕后，我们正在制定日程安排，以及会议召开所需的一切工作，包括组织食物、录像、挂绳等等。 感谢艾琳、卢卡、巴勃罗、兰尼、阿基尔和奥利弗！

把招工广告
